蚂蚁
小林勇 文·图
中国少年儿童出版社

[P2] 蚂蚁
小林 勇 文·图
中国少年儿童出版社

[P3] 三月里，天气还有点儿凉。
我看到院子里的阳光下，有蚂蚁在走动。

把墙角的枯叶拿开，就可以看见蚂蚁洞了。
蚂蚁爬进爬出，嘴里好像叼着东西。
仔细看看，原来是在搬运泥土。

我心想：应该来观察观察
蚂蚁的生活。
3

[P4] 过了几天，天气暖和了。洞口有
很多蚂蚁，好像要出来晒太阳。
洞口有很多强壮的蚂蚁在当卫兵。
只要卫兵蚂蚁用肚子在地上
做信号，其他的蚂蚁
就很快地躲进洞里。

[P5] 植物发芽的时候，蚂蚁会爬到
离洞口很远的地方去寻找食物。
蚂蚁爬到有很多蚜虫的树上，它用触角
去碰蚜虫的背部。这时，蚜虫的尾部就会
分泌出蜜水来，蚂蚁就去吃那些蜜水。

当我把脸靠近树枝，
想再仔细看看，
蚂蚁却很快地
跑掉了。

蚜虫和蚂蚁

[P6] 一只死的长脚蜂怎么会动呢？原来，是一只蚂蚁在旁边拉它。对蚂蚁来说，长脚蜂是一种很重要的食物。
蚂蚁把长脚蜂拉到洞口的时候，有很多同伴会出来帮忙，可是长脚蜂的身体实在太大了，没有办法搬进洞里。所以——
蚂蚁就会把长脚蜂的身体咬断。

[P7] 把蚂蚁洞挖开来看看，蚂蚁洞里的通道好像树根一样，一直伸到地下。路边和末端有不同的房间，房间里有许多的卵、蛹和幼虫。
这条通道有
一公尺长，
向下伸展，
前端又是一个小小的房间。
蚂蚁的通道

[P8] 雌蚁

雄蚁
(不久就会变成蚁后)

普通的工蚁
(雌蚁)

(雌蚁)

蚁后(雌蚁)

实际的大小

窝里有一只蚁后。蚁后会生育出许多工蚁，
还能生育好几只有翅膀的雌蚁和雄蚁。

[P9] 注意看，蚂蚁好像会做很多事。它们会互相碰碰嘴、舔舔身体，像是在洗脸。
蚂蚁会用嘴传递东西
身体脏了怎么办？
蚂蚁会互相舔身体，
把身体舔干净。
被舔的那一只蚂蚁
好像很舒服呢！

[P10] 蚂蚁会打架，也会用嘴互相咬。当别种蚂蚁来侵略时，它们会紧追不舍去咬对方，甚至把对方咬死。

常看到蚂蚁
互相碰过嘴以后，
就会用前脚的毛
摩擦触角。

跟别种蚂蚁打架，咬得好凶啊！

[P11] 五月底，一个闷热、没有风的日子。
在工蚁保护下，有翅膀的蚂蚁全部从洞里跑到洞口外。
到底发生了什么事呢？

[P12] 原来，雌蚁和雄蚁要结婚啦！
有翅膀的蚂蚁一下子全飞上天了，
这里那里，到处都飞着长了翅膀的蚂蚁。

[P13] 飞了一个多小时以后，雌雄蚁的交配完成了，
蚂蚁才回到地面。
长着翅膀的蚂蚁靠在石头的锐角上摩擦，
把翅膀磨掉，再开始寻找新家。

它选择一个比较干燥、平坦的石头，
从石头底下钻进去，建筑它的新家。
在这个小房间里，雌蚁就开始产卵。
这就是蚂蚁最早的家。
不久以后，这只雌蚁就会变成蚁后了。

卵经过了两个月，就变成蚂蚁。
卵 → 幼虫 → 蛹 → 蚂蚁

[P14] 作者介绍
小林 鼎
小林鼎于1916年生于日本名古屋，京都高等工艺学校(现京都工艺纤维大学)毕业后，进入国立美术研究所，跟随日本著名画家原田太郎学油画，受其影响颇深。小林鼎在第二次大战后某方历后，喜欢研究精密绘画，对摄影也有浓厚兴趣。他特别能迅速地与科学工作者结合创作科学美术，于1956年设立了日本理科美术协会。现在是日本美术家连盟的会员。小林鼎最擅长的是图画故事类的生物画，尤其是昆虫类。在画这本《蚂蚁》时，他亲自向昆虫学家近藤正树请教，在蚂蚁经常出入的地方，挖了一个二公尺宽、一点五公尺深的洞，在离地表的二十到五十公分的地方，发现了蚂蚁的洞穴。他看到很多蚂蚁慌慌张张地跑出来，也仔细观察了白色的卵和蛹，最大的收获，却是发现蚂蚁的六道，并不像一般推测所画的平直式通道，而是像树根一样，往四面八方伸展的立体式网状通道。
(京)新登字 084 号

Ants
By and Illustrated by Xiao Lin Yong
China Children's Publishing House

[P2] Ants
Xiao Lin Yong, text and illustrations
China Children's Publishing House

[P3] In March, the weather is still a bit cool.
I saw ants moving in the sunlight in the yard.

If you move the dry leaves at the corner of the wall, you can see the ant hole.
The ants crawl in and out, with something seemingly in their mouths.
Take a closer look, and you'll see they are carrying soil.

I thought: I should observe the ants' life.
3

[P4] A few days later, the weather warmed up. There were many ants at the entrance, as if they were coming out to sunbathe.
There were many strong ants guarding the entrance.
As soon as the guard ants use their bellies to signal on the ground, the other ants quickly hide inside the hole.

[P5] When plants sprout, ants will crawl to
places far from the nest entrance to search for food.
Ants climb onto trees with many aphids, using their antennae
to touch the aphids' backs. At this time, the aphids' tails will
secrete honeydew, and the ants will eat that honeydew.

When I brought my face close to the branch,
wanting to take a closer look,
the ants quickly
ran away.

Aphids and ants

[P6] How can a dead long-legged wasp move? It turns out, an ant is pulling it from the side. For ants, long-legged wasps are an important food source.
When the ant pulls the long-legged wasp to the entrance of the nest, many companions come out to help. But the wasp's body is simply too big to be carried into the hole. So——
The ants will bite the wasp's body into pieces.

[P7] Let's dig open an ant nest and take a look. The tunnels inside the ant nest are like tree roots, stretching deep underground. Along the way and at the ends, there are different rooms, each filled with many eggs, pupae, and larvae.
This tunnel is
one meter long,
stretching downward,
and at the front end is another small room.
Ant tunnel

There is one queen ant in the nest. The queen ant gives birth to many worker ants,
and can also give birth to several winged female and male ants.

[P9] Look closely, ants seem to do many things. They touch mouths and lick each other's bodies, as if washing their faces.
Ants use their mouths to pass things
What if their bodies get dirty?
Ants lick each other's bodies,
Cleaning them thoroughly.
The ant being licked
Seems very comfortable!

[P10] Ants fight and bite each other with their mouths. When ants of another species invade, they will chase and bite relentlessly, even biting the other to death.

Often, after ants touch mouths with each other,
they will rub their antennae
with the hairs on their front legs.

Fighting with ants of another species, biting fiercely!

[P11] Late May, a hot, windless day.
Under the protection of worker ants, winged ants all ran from the nest to the entrance.
What on earth is happening?

[P12] It turns out, the queen ants and male ants are getting married!
Winged ants suddenly flew up into the sky all at once,
here and there, winged ants were flying everywhere.

[P13] After flying for over an hour, the mating of the male and female ants was completed, and the ants returned to the ground.
Winged ants rub against the sharp edges of stones to wear off their wings, then begin searching for a new home.

It chooses a relatively dry and flat stone, drills underneath it, and builds its new home.
In this small room, the female ant begins laying eggs.
This is the earliest home of the ants.
Soon after, this female ant will become the queen ant.

After two months, the egg becomes an ant.
Egg → Larva → Pupa → Ant

[P14] Author Introduction
Kobayashi Isamu
Kobayashi Isamu was born in Nagoya, Japan in 1916. After graduating from Kyoto Higher Technical School (now Kyoto Institute of Technology and Fiber), he entered the National Institute of Fine Arts and studied oil painting under the renowned Japanese painter Harada Taro, greatly influenced by him. After World War II, he developed a passion for precise illustration and photography. He was particularly adept at collaborating with scientists to create scientific art, and in 1956, he established the Japan Society for Scientific Art. He is currently a member of the Japan Artists Association. Kobayashi Isamu is especially skilled in biological illustrations for picture storybooks, particularly insects. When illustrating this book 'Ants', he personally consulted entomologist Masaki Kondo. In an area where ants frequently appeared, he dug a hole two meters wide and 1.5 meters deep. At a depth of 20 to 50 centimeters below the surface, he discovered an ant nest. He observed many ants running frantically out, and carefully examined the white eggs and pupae. His greatest discovery, however, was that the ants' six tunnels were not the straight, flat passages commonly depicted, but rather a three-dimensional, network-like structure spreading in all directions, resembling tree roots.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《蚂蚁》的封面与封底，封面上有两只蚂蚁的插图及书名、作者信息，封底展示了蚂蚁巢穴的剖面图，并标注了阅读年龄建议、出版社及ISBN信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《蚂蚁》的扉页，展示了书名、作者信息及一只蚂蚁的插图，下方标注出版社名称。
[P3] 本页描绘了三月里院子里蚂蚁活动的场景，作者发现蚂蚁在墙角枯叶下搬运泥土，并决定观察它们的生活。
[P4] 天气转暖后，洞口聚集了许多蚂蚁，它们在晒太阳；同时，强壮的卫兵蚂蚁在洞口执勤，一旦发出信号，其他蚂蚁便会迅速躲进洞里。
[P5] 本页描绘了蚂蚁在植物发芽时外出觅食，通过触角触碰蚜虫获取蜜水的场景，并描述了观察者靠近时蚂蚁迅速逃跑的情形。
[P6] 本页描绘了蚂蚁搬运一只死长脚蜂的场景，由于长脚蜂体型过大无法搬进洞穴，蚂蚁们便将其身体咬断以便搬运。
[P7] 本页展示了蚂蚁巢穴的剖面图，描绘了其复杂的通道结构和不同功能的房间，包括储存卵、蛹和幼虫的区域，并标注了通道深度和长度。
[P8] 本页展示了蚂蚁不同种类的插图，包括雌蚁、雄蚁、工蚁和蚁后，并说明蚁后负责生育工蚁及有翅膀的雌蚁和雄蚁。
[P9] 本页通过插图和文字展示了蚂蚁互相用嘴传递东西以及清洁身体的行为，描述了它们通过舔舐彼此来保持清洁的社交行为。
[P10] 本页描绘了蚂蚁之间的打斗行为，包括同类间用触角和前脚互动，以及与别种蚂蚁激烈搏斗的场景。
[P11] 本页描绘了五月底一个闷热无风的日子，工蚁保护着有翅膀的蚂蚁从洞穴中跑到洞口外，画面引发疑问：到底发生了什么事？
[P12] 本页描绘了有翅膀的雌蚁和雄蚁在空中飞翔的场景，揭示了它们即将进行婚飞交配的行为。
[P13] 本页描述了雌雄蚂蚁交配后，雌蚁磨掉翅膀、寻找新家并开始产卵的过程，以及卵经过两个月发育成蚂蚁的生命周期阶段。
[P14] 本页为绘本《蚂蚁》的版权页和作者介绍，详细介绍了作者小林鼎的生平、艺术成就及创作《蚂蚁》时的实地考察经历，并列出了出版信息、版权归属和编辑人员名单。
